source_hash_scope: Working-tree bytes of the named committed files. The committed numerical run completed with a clean checkout. Later changes in this evidence publication affect documentation only.

implementation.equation: Regular constant descriptor E*x-prime + A*x = b(t). Exact closure derives hidden algebraic constraints and necessary forcing orders. A joint exact projection solves finite values, finite rates and every required delta-derivative coefficient.
implementation.storage: The canonical input is accepted charge/flux q-minus, including authored per-device startup IC storage. Exact left-nullspace constraints certify q-minus in range(E); the integrated equation is E*x-plus + A*xi-zero = q-minus. A higher-index neighboring block cannot make invalid charge on an algebraic row admissible.
implementation.audit: Audit every original finite equation, jump equation, impulse-chain coefficient and hidden constraint plus its derivative before returning. Exact integer products preserve overflowing cancellation and subnormal residuals.
implementation.numerical_gate: Componentwise backward error at most 128*f64::EPSILON*(nonzero_terms+1), without a current/charge floor or timestep regularization. Unrepresentable nonzero mappings and outputs fail explicitly.
implementation.development_defect: Original E/A equations alone did not audit the rate of an algebraic CCVS output current. Deliberate corruption of coordinate 15 passed that incomplete audit. Retaining and auditing differentiated hidden constraints repairs this test-gated prototype defect; no production event path consumed it.
implementation.limits: Prepared storage and temporary equation work are charged to existing resource ceilings; preparation/evaluation preserve typed cancellation and resource errors. This does not establish allocation-failure safety or whole-run memory/cancellation qualification.
implementation.runtime_admission: The entire transition module remains cfg(test). No circuit adapter, state acceptance or result route calls it. CCVS physical-event admission remains absent; the admitted family census remains 14 of 38 with existing instance predicates. Checkpoint identity remains v105.
implementation.lint_cleanup: Separate commit fixes eight existing strict-Clippy warnings in four periodic test fixtures. Fixture parameters, assertions and numerical tolerances are unchanged.
